project_type: Discord bot với TypeScript, module-based architecture
build_system: npm + tsc, custom build script copies assets/public folders and creates dist/data directory
test_command: npm run build && node dist/src/index.js (manual testing in Discord)
verification_instructions: 1. Build với npm run build. 2. Run bot với npm start. 3. Test commands trong Discord server: /shop, /balance, /inventory, purchase items. 4. Verify multi-currency displays, 3-column layout, tags, và purchase logic.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ folder generated by build (not checked in). data/*.json files are runtime data (coins.json, inventory.json, vip_custom_roles.json).
environment_constraints: Bot requires DISCORD_TOKEN, CLIENT_ID, GROQ_API_KEYS in .env. Guild context required for role management. Data files in data/ directory must be backward-compatible.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found - follow existing code patterns. Module structure: src/modules/*/entry_point.ts with commands Collection. Use emojis from src/config/emojis.ts. Defer replies immediately to avoid interaction timeout.
key_patterns: Commands always defer immediately with try-catch for expired interactions. Shop items stored in SHOP_ITEMS array with id, name, description, price, emoji, category, roleColor. Data stored in JSON files (coins.json, inventory.json). Embeds use Unicode box drawing for borders (╔ ╗ ╚ ╝ ║ ═). VIP roles (chu_banh_cuon, dau_bep, huyen_thoai, nguoi_sang_lap) have special privileges.
directory_structure: src/modules/ - bot modules with entry_point.ts each; src/config/ - configuration files; src/core/ - core systems; src/utils/ - utilities; data/ - JSON data files; dist/ - compiled output; assets/ - static assets like banners
